fp64_reference_policy: optional diagnostic only; neither CPU FP64 nor ANTs --float 0 is the acceptance target
arithmetic_policy: ordinary FP32 image and field arithmetic; no software-expanded floating point
comparison_domain: all declared forward and inverse grid points, including boundaries
host_fp64: native CPU bounded geometry/filter coefficients, joint-PDF total, scalar controls and output QA; parameter/CG and PDF states are float32
synthetic_failure_policy: preserve differences; distinguish algorithm/quality regressions from floating-point trajectory differences without assuming either cause
acceptance_basis: registration formulas, transform direction, geometry, boundaries and update order
finite results, deformation regularity and inverse consistency
synthetic known-transform accuracy and real-MRI registration quality
CPU/Metal reproducibility within useful numerical accuracy
performance with documented recipe and synchronization
reference_map_difference_role: diagnostic; rounding/FMA/reduction-dependent optimizer trajectories are not a hard failure by themselves
